--- STORY: WILDFIRE UPDATE ---
[CAM3 OX5]

[VO]
[CG: OREGON FIRE 80% CONTAINED]

FIRE MANAGERS SAY THEY WILL KEEP TWO CREWS ON THE LINE THROUGH THE END OF THE WEEK.
